title: eludite.editor.go_to_definition output
description: What Go To Definition did. From the UI thread (keys, the mouse) this is the state right after the request was sent, usually `loading`; from another thread (an agent) the call waits up to 5 s for the answer.

path.description: The document the request was made in.

line.description: 1-based line the request was made at.

column.description: 1-based column the request was made at.

state.description: `loading`: waiting for the language server; `navigated`: the target is open with the caret on it; `choose`: several targets, the picker is open (choose with `target`); `none`: no definition ("Cannot navigate to the symbol under the caret."); `failed`: the request failed (no language server, or an error).

targets.description: The definitions found, in the language server's order (at most 100).

path.description: Absolute path of the file that holds the definition.

metadata.description: True when the definition is in a referenced assembly: the file is the language server's metadata-as-source (decompiled) text and opens read-only.

title.description: The tab title the target opens with (`Foo.cs`, or `Foo [from metadata]`).

navigated.description: Where the caret is now, after `navigated`.
